mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Archmage of Runes.
# "Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast."  FDN Mocking Sprite's CostModifier
# (M7 record; M21 Watcher of the Spheres' B4-cost-modifier-watcher form).
# "Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, draw a card."  ZNR Umara Mystic's cast event
# (B10) over instants and sorceries; M21 Twinblade Assassins' "draw a card".
discount = CostModifier(
    filter=FOr(
        children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Instant'),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Sorcery'),
        ),
    ),
    controller_ref=ControllerRef.YOU,
    delta=CostDeltaReduceGeneric(amount=QConst(value=1)),
)
study = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CastSpellEvent(
        filter=FOr(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Instant'),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Sorcery'),
            ),
        ),
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
)
abilities = [discount, study, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, draw a card.

mapping.notes: Mocking Sprite's CostModifier (M7); cast trigger over instants and sorceries you cast (Umara Mystic's event) drawing one.
